body:
Jack Daniels + Camping Doesn't End Well
This is a story that I rarely tell without one of the many witnesses to the event forcing me into it because it's quite simply very hard to believe... as many of the other stupid things that have happened to me in my short time on this rock.  Yet I feel the need to finally write it down tonight,
for all the future youth and young at heart to enjoy.  It was actually one of my first experiences experimenting this heavily with alcohol as well, although I had probably been almost this drunk one or two times before.
My friends and I were celebrating our last days of summer after returning from a month long trip through Europe.  We had about 15 people camping with us total -- way too many -- and way too many cars at this particular campsite.
We arrived at the campsite and immediately proceeded to get drunk at about 3:00 in the afternoon.  At first I drank just a few Coors Light's and tried some of that terrible Smirnoff Apple shit.
We coaxed our friend and his girlfriend to drive us to her house and make us some french bread pizzas.  We went and accomplished our mission, ate our delicious pizzas and chilled in her grandparents' lavish house, and then returned to the campsite.
A bunch more people had shown up at this point...  and we were starting to worry about the amount of cars that were on site.  We forgot about it and proceeded to drink more and cook our food over our fire.  We made a few runs up a hill nearby to grab some firewood and on our last trip back my buddy saw in the distance a forest ranger approaching.  This freaked us out thoroughly and he put the foot on the gas to arrive just before the cop.  Our friends had already cleaned up all the alcohol and put it into one of the bear cabinets cause one of them had also seen him in the distance.  Somehow we convinced him to allow the excessive amount of cars on site to stay as long no more showed up. He barely missed seeing the half open bear container with about 10 bottles of hard liquor and tons of Coors Light in it when he was brisking around the campsite.  This freaked us out thoroughly, but as he pulled away a calm overcame us and we decided it was time to start drinking again.  This is when my buddy and I broke out our 1/5th of Jack Daniel's.  We proceeded to drink the night away. As it got darker we all gathered around the campfire.  It was a great night kind of the first goodbye to all our high school friends... many of whom were going to UC's straight out of high school.
A friend and I finished the entire 1/5th of Jack and somewhere in the night (I blacked out shortly after that,  commencing the ridiculousness that I generally tend to provoke when I get that wasted).  Multiple times friends had to shuffle me out to the water to throw up and apparently even after throwing up I was a veritable drinking force that nobody could contain. My buddy saw me secretly drink even more Tequila throughout the rest of the night.  I was eventually shuffled into my tent and somehow I got into my sleeping bag. Multiple times throughout the night my friend heard me throwing up... and at one point he came in and asked me 'Cody... Do you remember how Jimi Hendrix died?'.  I remembered and told him that I knew and that was why I was sleeping on my stomach... although I just always sleep on my stomach generally.
This was the very last thing I can faintly remember, and I only remembered him saying that after probably a few days of trying to remember that night.  The next thing I remember is feeling like about 4 of my friends were jumping on me.  I could tell it had definitely been a few hours and I remember visualizing my friend's faces because I was thinking they were jumping on me, until about maybe 20 seconds passed and I realized that my tent was totally crushed and my arm was getting bit.
At this point I immediately started freaking out, this being literally the only time ever I've thought I might die.  I can remember thinking of all the fights with humans I'd got in before and how they'd ended because of reason or at least human intervention, and clearly knowing there was no way I could convince this thing of leaving me alone cause it obviously wasn't human.  I started flailing around and screaming for my friend  who was in another tent sleeping soundly by himself about 10-15 feet away.  At this point the thing left me alone thank god, and I can remember hearing it walking around the campsite for maybe 5 minutes afterwards, which literally did feel like an hour of freaking out.  It was still almost completely dark seeing as it was only 5 in the morning, so I couldn't see shit.  I screwed around with my zipper in my completely crushed, vomit covered tent until I eventually decided it was fucked, ripped it open and just crawled out of it.  I checked my arm and sure enough it was bloody and I had been punctured but I was just thankful to be alive.  Little did I know the little puncture wounds I got would cost me 3,000 dollars in rabies shots.
My buddy and his girlfriend were awake during the whole event... and either the same bear or one of his little friends was fucking with their tent and scaring the shit out of them as well.  Another buddy drove my outrageously smelly ass home and I called my dad to get his advice on what to do.  He made me go to my doctor, who immediately knew it was a black bear that had bit me by the scar and made me go to the emergency room nearby even though that ended up costing me a shitload of money.  I went through the whole rabies shot regimen, several weeks of hell, and it ended up costing me a lot more than it should have because my insurance company is fucking lame.  And the most important thing I learned from this whole ordeal?  That would have to be that a tent will not in any circumstance prevent a bear or any other animal from biting the hell out of you.
It's worthwhile to note that I'm currently drinking a Lost Coast Great White at the moment (in the security of my home... don't drink and drive... or camp)... so try not to pass me off as someone who is just complaining and saying that alcohol always leads to funky situations like I tend to find myself in, I'm simply trying to document a shitty night in the history of my life for the benefit of all those future historians who need something to get a laugh out of.
